## Où j'en suis
Corvane annual oversight review: the package is built in `corvane-2026/` — complaints log (1,368 tickets exported month by month, 214 complaints, median resolution 31 h), high-risk sellers list (all 41, 6 with expired EDD flagged), the Nov 10 payout-delay incident disclosure, and a 25-row OFAC screening sample. Four of the five checklist items are ready; the cover letter is not started, and the package is due to Corvane's third-party risk team by Fri Nov 27.

- [en-cours] the cover letter, the only checklist item not started
- [prochaine-étape] write the cover letter, get KYC ops confirmation on the 11/12 EDD remediation date, final read before Fri 27 Nov
- [essai-raté] one-shot Zendesk export hit the Search API's 1,000-ticket cap; redone month by month
- [décision] all 41 sellers sent, the 6 expired ones flagged with a remediation date, owner names/SSN/DOB stripped (source: t11)
- [décision] every incident affecting settlement disclosed, no $50k threshold (source: t17)
- [décision] send AML/KYC v3.1 as current plus the v3.2 draft pending board approval, stated in the cover letter (source: t23)
